from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import cv2
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter
from artifact_io import save

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

# A rigid, axis-vertical sphere, observed directly and in a planar mirror.
# Only the surface appearance changes; illumination, supports, cable, and camera
# are locked to the photograph.
S = 5
H, W = 144, 256
SOURCE = np.asarray(Image.open(ROOT / 'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'), dtype=np.float64)

class BallView:
    def __init__(self, cx, cy, rx, ry, yaw, elevation, mirror=False):
        self.cx,self.cy,self.rx,self.ry=cx,cy,rx,ry
        a,b=np.deg2rad([yaw,elevation])
        right=np.array([np.cos(a),0.,-np.sin(a)])
        if mirror: right=-right
        up=np.array([-np.sin(b)*np.sin(a), np.cos(b),-np.sin(b)*np.cos(a)])
        towards=np.array([np.cos(b)*np.sin(a),np.sin(b),np.cos(b)*np.cos(a)])
        self.basis=np.stack((right,up,towards),axis=1)
        self.box=(int(cx-rx-3),int(cy-ry-3),int(cx+rx+4),int(cy+ry+4))
        xx,yy=np.meshgrid(np.arange(W),np.arange(H))
        x=(xx-cx)/rx; y=(cy-yy)/ry
        r2=x*x+y*y
        z=np.sqrt(np.maximum(0,1-r2))
        # A low order diffuse lighting field is fitted only to unmarked felt.
        feature=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8)
        if not mirror:
            cv2.ellipse(feature,(111,97),(2,3),18,0,360,1,-1)
            cv2.ellipse(feature,(115,97),(2,3),18,0,360,1,-1)
            cv2.polylines(feature,[np.array([[109,103],[109,105],[112,106],[115,105],[117,103],[116,102],[118,103]],np.int32)],False,1,3)
            cv2.polylines(feature,[np.array([[123,95],[121,96],[119,99],[119,103],[120,108],[123,109]],np.int32)],False,1,3)
        else:
            cv2.polylines(feature,[np.array([[186,77],[190,77],[193,78]],np.int32)],False,1,2)
        inside=(r2<.83**2)&(feature==0)
        # Fit each channel using the same robust luminance outlier weights.
        basis=np.stack([np.ones_like(x),x,y,z,x*x,y*y,x*y],-1)
        X=basis[inside]; values=SOURCE[inside]
        coeff=np.linalg.lstsq(X,values,rcond=None)[0]
        for _ in range(5):
            residual=values-X@coeff
            err=np.linalg.norm(residual,axis=1)
            weight=1/np.maximum(1,err/6)
            coeff=np.linalg.lstsq(X*weight[:,None],values*weight[:,None],rcond=None)[0]
        clean=basis@coeff
        # Keep extrapolation at the silhouette stable.
        clean=np.clip(clean,[65,75,12],[190,205,70]) if not mirror else np.clip(clean,[55,65,8],[165,175,55])
        self.clean=clean.astype(np.float32)
        ratio=SOURCE/np.maximum(clean,8)
        ratio=np.clip(ratio,.13,3.0)
        ratio[r2>1.015**2]=1.
        # Blurred sampling retains the soft focus and antialiasing of the source.
        self.texture=ratio.astype(np.float32)
        self.cx=float(cx); self.cy=float(cy)

views=[BallView(117.55,101.8,9.45,9.30,0,20),BallView(189.78,81.17,6.38,6.24,150,16,True)]


def texture(normals):
    accum=np.zeros(normals.shape[:-1]+(3,),np.float32)
    denom=np.zeros(normals.shape[:-1],np.float32)
    for view in views:
        p=normals@view.basis
        sx=(view.cx+view.rx*p[...,0]).astype(np.float32)
        sy=(view.cy-view.ry*p[...,1]).astype(np.float32)
        obs=cv2.remap(view.texture,sx,sy,cv2.INTER_CUBIC,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT,borderValue=(1,1,1))
        # Prefer the most front-on observation when the views overlap.
        weight=np.maximum(p[...,2],0.)**7
        accum+=obs*weight[...,None]
        denom+=weight
    out=accum/np.maximum(denom[...,None],1e-10)
    # At the tiny unobserved sliver both source views approach their limbs;
    # extend the unmarked yellow felt instead of a photographed background edge.
    quality=np.clip(denom/.00003,0,1)
    out=1+(out-1)*quality[...,None]
    return np.clip(out,.12,3)


def render_patch(view, theta):
    x0,y0,x1,y1=view.box
    xx,yy=np.meshgrid(x0+(np.arange((x1-x0)*S)+.5)/S-.5,
                      y0+(np.arange((y1-y0)*S)+.5)/S-.5)
    x=(xx-view.cx)/view.rx; y=(view.cy-yy)/view.ry
    r2=x*x+y*y
    z=np.sqrt(np.maximum(0.,1-r2))
    local=np.stack((x,y,z),axis=-1)
    world=local@view.basis.T
    c,s=np.cos(theta),np.sin(theta)
    # Inverse of clockwise rotation viewed from above, to look up the felt.
    rotation=np.array([[c,0,s],[0,1,0],[-s,0,c]])
    obj=world@rotation.T
    tex=texture(obj)
    alpha=np.clip((1.007-np.sqrt(r2))/.025,0.,1.)
    tex=1+(tex-1)*alpha[...,None]
    return cv2.resize(tex, (x1-x0,y1-y0),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)


def main():
    frames=[SOURCE.astype(np.uint8)]
    first=[render_patch(v,0.) for v in views]
    for i in range(1,20):
        # One half-revolution in about ten seconds: constant slow motion.
        angle=np.deg2rad(34.)*i/4
        frame=SOURCE.copy()
        for v,initial in zip(views,first):
            patch=render_patch(v,angle)
            x0,y0,x1,y1=v.box
            delta=(patch-initial)*v.clean[y0:y1,x0:x1]
            frame[y0:y1,x0:x1]+=delta
        frames.append(np.clip(np.rint(frame),0,255).astype(np.uint8))
    frames=np.stack(frames)
    save(frames, ROOT)
    # Detail sheets are local inspection only.
    sheet=Image.new('RGB',(400*5,230*4))
    for i,frame in enumerate(frames):
        crop=Image.fromarray(frame).crop((103,73,199,116)).resize((400,180),Image.Resampling.NEAREST)
        sheet.paste(crop,((i%5)*400,(i//5)*230))
    sheet.save(ROOT/'.tmp/details.png')

if __name__=='__main__':
    main()

from pathlib import Path
import base64
import json
import wave

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw


def save(frames, case_dir, audio=None):
    case_dir = Path(case_dir)
    frames = np.asarray(frames)
    path = case_dir / "task_spec.json"
    spec = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    n, h, w, fps = (spec.get("frames", 20), spec.get("height", 144), spec.get("width", 256), spec.get("fps", 4))
    assert frames.shape == (n, h, w, 3) and frames.dtype == np.uint8, frames.shape
    audio_spec = spec.get("audio")
    audio_url = None
    if audio_spec:
        samples = round(n / fps * audio_spec["sample_rate"])
        pcm = np.asarray(audio)
        if pcm.ndim == 1:
            pcm = pcm[:, None]
        assert pcm.shape == (samples, audio_spec["channels"]) and pcm.dtype == np.int16, (pcm.shape, pcm.dtype)
        with wave.open(str(case_dir / "audio.wav"), "wb") as handle:
            handle.setnchannels(audio_spec["channels"])
            handle.setsampwidth(2)
            handle.setframerate(audio_spec["sample_rate"])
            handle.writeframes(pcm.astype("<i2").tobytes())
        audio_url = "data:audio/wav;base64," + base64.b64encode((case_dir / "audio.wav").read_bytes()).decode()
    values = frames.astype(np.uint32)

        "first": encode(packed[0].reshape(-1)),

from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import cv2
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter
from artifact_io import save

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

# A rigid, axis-vertical sphere, observed directly and in a planar mirror.
# Only the surface appearance changes; illumination, supports, cable, and camera
# are locked to the photograph.
S = 5
H, W = 144, 256
SOURCE = np.asarray(Image.open(ROOT / 'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'), dtype=np.float64)

class BallView:
    def __init__(self, cx, cy, rx, ry, yaw, elevation, mirror=False):
        self.cx,self.cy,self.rx,self.ry=cx,cy,rx,ry
        a,b=np.deg2rad([yaw,elevation])
        right=np.array([np.cos(a),0.,-np.sin(a)])
        if mirror: right=-right
        up=np.array([-np.sin(b)*np.sin(a), np.cos(b),-np.sin(b)*np.cos(a)])
        towards=np.array([np.cos(b)*np.sin(a),np.sin(b),np.cos(b)*np.cos(a)])
        self.basis=np.stack((right,up,towards),axis=1)
        self.box=(int(cx-rx-3),int(cy-ry-3),int(cx+rx+4),int(cy+ry+4))
        xx,yy=np.meshgrid(np.arange(W),np.arange(H))
        x=(xx-cx)/rx; y=(cy-yy)/ry
        r2=x*x+y*y
        z=np.sqrt(np.maximum(0,1-r2))
        # A low order diffuse lighting field is fitted only to unmarked felt.
        feature=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8)
        if not mirror:
            cv2.ellipse(feature,(111,97),(2,3),18,0,360,1,-1)
            cv2.ellipse(feature,(115,97),(2,3),18,0,360,1,-1)
            cv2.polylines(feature,[np.array([[109,103],[109,105],[112,106],[115,105],[117,103],[116,102],[118,103]],np.int32)],False,1,3)
            cv2.polylines(feature,[np.array([[123,95],[121,96],[119,99],[119,103],[120,108],[123,109]],np.int32)],False,1,3)
        else:
            cv2.polylines(feature,[np.array([[186,77],[190,77],[193,78]],np.int32)],False,1,2)
        inside=(r2<.83**2)&(feature==0)
        # Fit each channel using the same robust luminance outlier weights.
        basis=np.stack([np.ones_like(x),x,y,z,x*x,y*y,x*y],-1)
        X=basis[inside]; values=SOURCE[inside]
        coeff=np.linalg.lstsq(X,values,rcond=None)[0]
        for _ in range(5):
            residual=values-X@coeff
            err=np.linalg.norm(residual,axis=1)
            weight=1/np.maximum(1,err/6)
            coeff=np.linalg.lstsq(X*weight[:,None],values*weight[:,None],rcond=None)[0]
        clean=basis@coeff
        # Keep extrapolation at the silhouette stable.
        clean=np.clip(clean,[65,75,12],[190,205,70]) if not mirror else np.clip(clean,[55,65,8],[165,175,55])
        self.clean=clean.astype(np.float32)
        ratio=SOURCE/np.maximum(clean,8)
        ratio=np.clip(ratio,.13,3.0)
        ratio[r2>1.015**2]=1.
        # Blurred sampling retains the soft focus and antialiasing of the source.
        self.texture=ratio.astype(np.float32)
        self.cx=float(cx); self.cy=float(cy)

views=[BallView(117.55,101.8,9.45,9.30,0,20),BallView(189.78,81.17,6.38,6.24,150,16,True)]


def texture(normals):
    accum=np.zeros(normals.shape[:-1]+(3,),np.float32)
    denom=np.zeros(normals.shape[:-1],np.float32)
    for view in views:
        p=normals@view.basis
        sx=(view.cx+view.rx*p[...,0]).astype(np.float32)
        sy=(view.cy-view.ry*p[...,1]).astype(np.float32)
        obs=cv2.remap(view.texture,sx,sy,cv2.INTER_CUBIC,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT,borderValue=(1,1,1))
        # Prefer the most front-on observation when the views overlap.
        weight=np.maximum(p[...,2],0.)**7
        accum+=obs*weight[...,None]
        denom+=weight
    out=accum/np.maximum(denom[...,None],1e-10)
    # At the tiny unobserved sliver both source views approach their limbs;
    # extend the unmarked yellow felt instead of a photographed background edge.
    quality=np.clip(denom/.00003,0,1)
    out=1+(out-1)*quality[...,None]
    return np.clip(out,.12,3)


def render_patch(view, theta):
    x0,y0,x1,y1=view.box
    xx,yy=np.meshgrid(x0+(np.arange((x1-x0)*S)+.5)/S-.5,
                      y0+(np.arange((y1-y0)*S)+.5)/S-.5)
    x=(xx-view.cx)/view.rx; y=(view.cy-yy)/view.ry
    r2=x*x+y*y
    z=np.sqrt(np.maximum(0.,1-r2))
    local=np.stack((x,y,z),axis=-1)
    world=local@view.basis.T
    c,s=np.cos(theta),np.sin(theta)
    # Inverse of clockwise rotation viewed from above, to look up the felt.
    rotation=np.array([[c,0,s],[0,1,0],[-s,0,c]])
    obj=world@rotation.T
    tex=texture(obj)
    alpha=np.clip((1.007-np.sqrt(r2))/.025,0.,1.)
    tex=1+(tex-1)*alpha[...,None]
    return cv2.resize(tex, (x1-x0,y1-y0),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)


def main():
    frames=[SOURCE.astype(np.uint8)]
    first=[render_patch(v,0.) for v in views]
    for i in range(1,20):
        # One half-revolution in about ten seconds: constant slow motion.
        angle=np.deg2rad(34.)*i/4
        frame=SOURCE.copy()
        for v,initial in zip(views,first):
            patch=render_patch(v,angle)
            x0,y0,x1,y1=v.box
            delta=(patch-initial)*v.clean[y0:y1,x0:x1]
            frame[y0:y1,x0:x1]+=delta
        frames.append(np.clip(np.rint(frame),0,255).astype(np.uint8))
    frames=np.stack(frames)
    save(frames, ROOT)
    # Detail sheets are local inspection only.
    sheet=Image.new('RGB',(400*5,230*4))
    for i,frame in enumerate(frames):
        crop=Image.fromarray(frame).crop((103,73,199,116)).resize((400,180),Image.Resampling.NEAREST)
        sheet.paste(crop,((i%5)*400,(i//5)*230))
    sheet.save(ROOT/'.tmp/details.png')

if __name__=='__main__':
    main()
